content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common, and it's usually habit more than hunger. Tonight, try a short pause before you go in, about a minute or two, since toddlers often settle themselves back down. If you do go in, keep it boring: low voice, a hand on the back, no lights, no picking him up, and leave while he's still a little awake. Doing the same thing every time is what makes it stick.
